rows.en: ???: "Father! Father!"
?????: "What a racket. What's the matter, Ciel?"
Ciel: "What do you mean, what's the matter?!
Is it true that Flamuelk has fallen?!"
?????: "...Calm down. Just who is spreading
such rumors?"
Ciel: "Rumors...? Are you saying it's a lie?
But our communications with Flamuelk have been cut off, too.
And the enemy's been more active these past few days.
All of it makes sense if we assume
the castle has fallen."
?????: "Are you saying you cannot believe
your own father's word?
The word of Garyud Via Vratzen?"
Ciel: "..."
Garyud: "Ciel. This is a Zigrim plot
to unsettle us. You mustn't let yourself be misled
by such malicious rumors."
Ciel: "...I see. 'A Zigrim plot,' is it?"
Garyud: "Indeed.
This proves that the enemy is running out of breathing room, too.
Perhaps the time has come to make our move.
Ciel, leave the fort and head for Krondem.
Tyron should already have his forces assembled there.
Strike the Zigrim army from the flank,
and we'll catch them between us."
Ciel: "...Krondem? Tyron's there?"
Garyud: "That's right. Ciel, you'll go, won't you?"
Ciel: "If that is your order."
Garyud: "Very well. Then I order you to go."
Ciel: "Understood. Ciel Ren Vratzen
is commencing operations at once!"
Garyud: "Y-Yes. That's a fine response."
Ciel: "I have your example to follow, Father."
Garyud: "Heh... Well said.
...Ciel."
Ciel: "Yes?"
Garyud: "You are a woman.
Surely being a knight all your life isn't your only path.
It's about time you..."
Ciel: "This again?
I have no intention of marrying."
Garyud: "Keep saying that,
and eventually no one will want you."
Ciel: "If that happens, I'm perfectly content.
I'll simply keep looking after you, Father.
Besides, men who think women are just tools for bearing children
are far too common. Men and women are fundamentally the same. Believing women must bear
and raise children simply because they're women is male selfishness.
That's how self-centered men are."
Garyud: "But not all men are like that."
Ciel: "Yes, that's true. Like you, Father."
Garyud: "Sigh... Well, never mind.
In any case, get ready and leave at once.
Every moment counts for this operation."
Ciel: "Understood. I'll take my leave, then."
Garyud: "She was unusually agreeable today.
Has she grown up that much?
But she resembles Phyllis more and more..."
Ymir: "Is everyone here?"
Celica: "Hmm? Ai's not here."
Arthur: "Come to think of it, I saw her in the kitchen."
Clovis: "Honestly, what is she doing?
Hey, Touya. Go get her."
Touya: "Huh?"
Clovis: "You and she seem to get along strangely well.
You're the right man for the job. Or don't you want to?"
Touya: "...It's not that I don't want to..."
Clovis: "Then go get her."
Touya: "...All right, all right! I'll go!
You really work people hard, you know...
Come on, Yamato. Let's go."
Clovis: "...Phew."
Yamato: "Ah! You're really relieved now!"
Clovis: "Ghh! D-Don't come any closer! Shoo! Shoo!"
Touya: "...Is that why you're sending me?"
Arthur: "Now, now. It's true that, after Queen Alforina,
Touya is Ai's favorite.
Please do us this favor."
Touya: "...All right already."
Yamato: "That left a bad taste in my mouth..."
Touya: "Hey, come on. Stop sulking already."
Yamato: "He shooed me away like I was some kind of pest...
Maybe I should sneak into Clovis's bed next time?"
Touya: "Wouldn't that turn into something you couldn't laugh off?"
Yamato: "Oh, that... Huh?"
Touya: "What's wrong?"
Yamato: "Isn't that Prince Cain?"
Touya: "Come to think of it, he wasn't on the bridge either."
Yamato: "That's the way to the hangar..."
Follow Cain
Go get Ai
Touya: "I'm a little curious. Let's go."
Yamato: "Huh? What about Ai?"
Touya: "Later."
Yamato: "...He is heading for the hangar."
Touya: "What's he up to?"
Yamato: "Oh, he stopped.
Touya, hide!"
Cain: "..."
Touya: "..."
Yamato: "..."
Cain: "..."
Touya: "Phew... We managed not to get spotted, huh?"
Yamato: "Y-Yeah. Probably..."
Touya: "All right, let's go."
Yamato: "...That's the mech Prince Cain arrived in...
What's he doing staring up at it?"
Cain: "It's quite a fine mech, isn't it?
Stop hiding over there and come on out."
Touya: "What...? You knew we were there...?"
Cain: "Am I really that untrustworthy?
...Well, perhaps it's too much to ask you to trust me."
Touya: "..."
Cain: "It doesn't matter. I'll just do what I have to do.
That's why I built this thing."
Yamato: "But isn't that a mech from the Kingdom of Agarthia,
though?"
Cain: "It is. But it's a different beast inside.
And I haven't used its real power yet."
Touya: "Its real power?"
Cain: "Heh heh heh... That's a secret.
But I may be able to show it off soon. Right in front of you."
Touya: "Something about the way you put that bothers me, but whatever.
More importantly, why did you come here?"
Cain: "To talk to you."
Touya: "M-Me?"
Cain: "Personal curiosity, perhaps?
Are you satisfied with your current situation?
You've suddenly been brought here and forced
to fight in a Spirit Mech."
Touya: "Satisfied? I don't even know what's going on myself.
But right now, I can't forgive the people of that country called Zigrim,
and I don't like those things called ≪Ze=Ode≫,
either."
Cain: "You're... honest.
But you have doubts about fighting.
Am I wrong?"
Touya: "Of course I do.
I never even dreamed
I'd end up fighting in a robot.
But if there's something I can do,
I want to do it.
Besides, sitting back and watching just isn't my style."
Cain: "Then wouldn't you like to go somewhere more rewarding?
That talent of yours... You got into a Spirit Mech for the first time and piloted it effortlessly.
Somewhere you could make full use of that talent."
Touya: "What do you mean?"
Cain: "Somewhere we can revolutionize this world."
Touya: "You... Who are you?"
Cain: "Just a 'former' prince.
Touya... Think about what I said...
Staying here will only bring you misery.
Well, I suppose it's time I returned to the bridge."
Touya: "H-Hey! Wait a minute!
...Damn it, what's with that guy?"
Yamato: "..."
Touya: "Well, whatever. Let's go get Ai, then."
Ai: "It's finally ready!
All right, now I just put this in the oven..."
Touya: "...You were still making them?"
Ai: "Wah! D-Don't suddenly speak to me from behind!"
Touya: "How's it going? Think they'll turn out well?"
Ai: "Of course! There's nothing little Ai can't do!"
Touya: "Well, you've spent so long making them.
They must be some rich cookies by now, huh?"
Ai: "What's that supposed to mean? You picking a fight?"
Yamato: "Okay, stop, stop.
We're almost at Belnea Fort.
There's a briefing, so hurry up and come to the bridge."
Ai: "Aww..."
Yamato: "Don't give me 'aww'!
They'll be fine even if they're not fresh from the oven, right?
Or do they only taste good when they're freshly baked?"
Ai: "O-Of course not!
All right! I'll go, okay?!"
Ai: "It's finally ready!
All right, now I just put this in the oven..."
Touya: "...What did you do to make it end up like this?"
Ai: "Wah! D-Don't suddenly speak to me from behind!"
Touya: "Never mind that. What's with this disaster?"
Ai: "Oh, shut up.
This was an unfortunate accident that happened entirely by chance."
Touya: "It looks to me like the inevitable result
of someone's handiwork."
Ai: "Wh-What?! Keep that up and I won't share any
with you later!"
Touya: "Oh? You were thinking of sharing with me?"
Ai: "If there are any left. First, I have to show Alforina
what I can do. You come after that."
Touya: "She's lucky she hasn't seen what went into them."
Ai: "I'm gonna blow a fuse!"
Yamato: "Okay, stop, stop.
We're almost at Belnea Fort.
There's a briefing, so hurry up and come to the bridge."
Ai: "Aww..."
Yamato: "Don't give me 'aww'!
They'll be fine even if they're not fresh from the oven, right?
Or do they only taste good when they're freshly baked?"
Ai: "O-Of course not!
All right! I'll go, okay?!"
Touya: "...What did you do to make it end up like this?"
Yamato: "She's already gone to the bridge, hasn't she?
Let's head back too."
